description: Adds eight momentary buttons to a MetaModule Hub patch, standing for the hardware's MetaButtons expander

params.text: Stands for one of the expander's eight buttons; drag from the small circle beside it onto any control in the patch and that control then follows this button

notes: A button does nothing until it is mapped. Drag from the coloured circle beside it onto a knob or switch anywhere in the patch.
It goes anywhere in the rack: the Hub finds it by looking through the patch rather than by looking beside itself, so it does not have to be next to the Hub.
Up to four of these work at once, each with its own address. The address shows at the foot of the panel; clicking it steps through the four, and it turns red when two clash.
menu: Address: 1, 2, 3, 4 — sets which of the four button expanders this one stands for
